index.cmimi-perfshirjet-perjashtimet-dhe: The price, inclusions, exclusions and conditions are visible before you decide. Clarity comes before beauty.
index.nje-person-real-ne: A real person on the other side, following your request from the first message to your return.
index.cdo-udhetim-nis-nga: Every journey begins with how you wish to experience it.
index.na-tregoni-datat-dhe: Tell us your dates and the pace you prefer; we will propose the options.
index.nje-udhetim-i-menduar: A journey considered down to the detail.
index.ide-te-bukura-pa: Beautiful ideas without the stress of organising: itinerary, inclusions and conditions explained.
index.oraret-bagazhet-transfertat-dhe: We clarify timetables, luggage, transfers and policies from the start, with a clear price.
index.ne-merremi-me-detajet: We take care of the details; you focus on the journey.
index.proces-i-qarte-afate: A clear process, response times and a contact who knows your request.
index.zbuloni-me-shume-me: Discover more, with a smart plan.
index.sugjerime-lokale-kohe-e: Local suggestions, free time and options — some cities are best discovered unhurried.
index.koordinim-dhe-buxhet-i: Coordination and a shared budget, with group terms and payments set out clearly.
index.na-e-tregoni-me: Tell us in your own words. We will look together at whether, and how, it can be done.
index.nga-ideja-te-kthimi: From the first idea to the return home, in six steps.
index.cfare-mund-te-prisni: What you can expect from us at every stage of the journey.
index.pergjigje-te-shpejta-dhe: Prompt replies and precise questions: dates, departure, travellers, budget, preferences.
index.opsione-te-krahasueshme-me: Comparable options, with total price, inclusions, exclusions and validity period.
index.konfirmim-i-shkruar-pa: Written confirmation, without ambiguity: names, dates, documents, payment, conditions.
index.kujtese-e-dobishme-dhe: A useful reminder, not an excessive one: check-in, luggage, documents, transfer, contact.
index.nje-kanal-i-qarte: A clear channel for assistance, with contact hours and an emergency procedure.
index.falenderim-feedback-me-leje: A thank-you, feedback with your permission, and follow-up on any unresolved issue.
index.e-perdorim-kete-fjale: We use this word only when we can explain it: why this hotel, why these dates, why this price. And there are six things we never do, because they damage trust faster than any logistical mistake.
index.nuk-japim-cmim-final: We do not give a final price without checking dates, availability and conditions.
index.nuk-komunikojme-perfshirje-qe: We do not communicate inclusions that have not been confirmed.
index.nuk-fshehim-kushte-tarifa: We do not hide conditions, fees or exclusions in small print.
index.nuk-perdorim-superlativa-dhe: We do not use superlatives or guarantees that we cannot prove.
index.nuk-ushtrojme-presion-me: We do not apply pressure with “offer ends soon” when it is not true.
index.nuk-e-leme-nje: We never leave a message unanswered: even when we have no solution yet, we tell you when you will have one.
index.na-tregoni-pak-per: Tell us a little about your journey.
index.plotesoni-cfare-dini-pjesen: Fill in what you know; we will clarify the rest together. The form prepares a well-ordered message, which you send to us with one click.

index.na-shkruani-ne-whatsapp: {{#WHATSAPP}}Write to us on WhatsApp ({{PHONE_DISPLAY}}), our main channel, or fill in the request form.{{/WHATSAPP}}{{#NO_WHATSAPP}}Fill in the request form or write to us on Instagram, @{{INSTAGRAM}}.{{/NO_WHATSAPP}} It helps us to know the destination or idea, the dates or your flexibility, the number of travellers and an approximate budget.
index.kur-eshte-cmimi-final: When is the final price confirmed?
index.cmimi-final-konfirmohet-pas: The final price is confirmed once the dates, availability and conditions have been checked. Until then, every figure is indicative, and we will say so.
index.cmimin-total-cfare-perfshihet: The total price, what is included, what is not included, the validity period and the main conditions. When there is more than one option, we present them so that they are easy to compare.
index.nuk-e-kam-vendosur: I have not yet decided on a destination. Can you help?
index.po-na-tregoni-datat: Yes. Tell us your dates and the pace you prefer — relaxed, active, seaside, city — and we will propose the options.
index.po-nese-me-duhet: And if I need to change or cancel?
index.kushtet-e-ndryshimit-dhe: The terms for changes and cancellation depend on the offer. You see them in writing before you book, not after.
index.sa-shpejt-merr-pergjigje: How soon will I receive a reply?
index.konfirmojme-marrjen-e-kerkeses: We confirm receipt of your request and, if it needs more time, we tell you when you will have the answer. If there is something we do not know, we say “we are checking”.
index.ku-do-tju-conte: Where would a free weekend take you?
index.zgjidhni-datat-ne-ju: Choose your dates; we will help you find the right combination of flight and stay.
index.te-dhenat-nuk-ruhen: Your data is not stored on this page.
index.nese-na-duhet-me: If we need more time, we will tell you when you will have the answer.
attr.doktrina-e-limetravel-shtate: LimeTravel Principles: the seven principles that guide every offer and every message, the team’s values and our commitment to clients.
attr.doktrina-e-limetravel-lets: LimeTravel Principles — Let’s live a little bit
attr.shtate-parimet-vlerat-e: The seven principles, the team’s values and our commitment to clients.
doktrina.limetravel-ekziston-qe-njerezit: LimeTravel exists so that people can live a little more: pause their routine for a few days and return with something they remember.
doktrina.lets-live-a-little-2: “Let’s live a little bit” is our invitation. It is not a promise of luxury or of the “perfect trip”; it is a quiet invitation to change pace. We take care of the details — dates, hotel, flight, conditions — so that you have time to enjoy what comes next.
doktrina.kur-nje-vendim-nuk: When a decision is unclear, we return to one question:
doktrina.a-e-ben-kjo: Does this make the client’s journey easier to plan and more beautiful to remember?
doktrina.te-ndihmojme-njerezit-te: To help people choose and organise journeys with clear information, human care and curated recommendations.
doktrina.te-behemi-nje-emer: To become a trusted name for travellers who value experience, transparency and personal service.
doktrina.udhetime-te-menduara-me: Thoughtfully planned journeys, from the first idea to the return home.
doktrina.lets-live-a-little-3: “Let’s live a little bit” says why we travel. “Travel thoughtfully” says how we shape journeys.
doktrina.keto-shtate-parime-drejtojne: These seven principles guide every offer, every message and every decision of the team.
doktrina.jetojme-pak-me-shume: We live a little more, not more than that.
doktrina.ftesa-jone-eshte-e: Our invitation is a measured one: real moments, not exaggeration.
doktrina.cmimi-perfshirjet-perjashtimet-: The price, inclusions, exclusions and conditions are visible before the client decides.
doktrina.nje-person-real-ne: A real person on the other side.
doktrina.cdo-kerkese-ka-nje: Every request has a name that follows it through to the end.
doktrina.e-perdorim-vetem-kur: We use it only when we can explain it: why this hotel, why these dates, why this price.
doktrina.kujdes-per-detajin-qe: Care for the detail that goes unseen.
doktrina.bagazhi-transferta-dokumentet-d: Luggage, transfers, documents and deadlines save a journey more than a beautiful photograph.
doktrina.e-verteta-edhe-kur: The truth, even when it is unwelcome.
doktrina.nese-nuk-e-dime: If we do not know, we say “we are checking”. We do not promise what we cannot keep.
doktrina.komunikim-i-ngrohte-pa: Warm communication, without superlatives and without pressure.
doktrina.kater-vlera-e-bejne: Four values make the brand recognisable at every point of contact, from Instagram to the last phone call before departure.
doktrina.e-qete-e-kuruar: Calm, curated, with taste. Never snobbish or cold.
doktrina.e-sakte-transparente-e: Precise, transparent, accountable; conditions are visible from the start.
doktrina.frymezon-dhe-zbulon-vende: Inspires and discovers places with perspective, not cliché.
doktrina.e-afert-e-sjellshme: Approachable, courteous, easy to understand; speaks like a good adviser.
doktrina.keto-gjashte-gjera-e: These six things damage trust faster than any logistical mistake.
doktrina.nuk-e-leme-nje: We never leave a message unanswered: even when we have no solution yet, we tell the client when they will have one.
doktrina.cdo-klient-i-limetravel: Every LimeTravel client can expect five things, without exception:
doktrina.nje-person-qe-e: A person who follows the request from the first message to the return home.
doktrina.cmim-e-kushte-qe: A price and conditions that do not change silently.
doktrina.pergjigje-te-sinqerta-edhe: Honest answers, even when they are “we are checking”.
doktrina.nje-udhetim-qe-te: A journey that lets you live a little more.
attr.si-i-trajton-kjo: How this site handles your data: no tracking cookies, no analytics and no storage of the form.
attr.si-i-trajton-kjo-2: How this site handles your data.
privatesia.kjo-faqe-eshte-ndertuar: This site is built to collect as little data as possible.
privatesia.cfare-nuk-ben-kjo: What this site does not do
privatesia.nuk-perdor-cookies-gjurmuese: It does not use tracking cookies, nor analytics or advertising tools.
privatesia.nuk-ngarkon-shkronja-skripte: It does not load fonts, scripts or images from third parties.
privatesia.nuk-e-ruan-dhe: It does not store, or send to our server, what you write in the request form.
privatesia.formulari-punon-vetem-ne: The form works only in your browser: it prepares a message, which you yourself choose to send through WhatsApp, email or another contact channel shown on the site. From that moment, the message is handled according to the rules of the service you use to send it.
privatesia.te-dhenat-qe-na: We use the data you send us only to answer your request and to prepare the travel proposal.
privatesia.si-cdo-faqe-interneti: Like any website, the hosting provider may temporarily record technical data about a visit, such as the IP address and browser type, for the security and operation of the service.
privatesia.per-cdo-pyetje-rreth: For any question about your data, write to us on WhatsApp{{#WHATSAPP}} ({{PHONE_DISPLAY}}){{/WHATSAPP}} or on Instagram: @{{INSTAGRAM}}{{#EMAIL}} or at {{EMAIL}}{{/EMAIL}}.
